label: About
title: About The Road Lets Weather Through
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 48 recent saved-signal files and 6 captured links, then narrowed the page to 6 source windows around @bagdelete and @OcramRatte, plus 4 more. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became The Road Lets Weather Through: Landscape of offset asphalt arcs enclosing a near-black navy void beneath white cumulus. A large railed arc curls into translucent pointed fins; a second lies low with faint warm light. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 6 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against Silver-railed sweeping asphalt and translucent pointed fins, Warm reclining left roadway arc, and Closely striped foreground road edge.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque fits assembled, experimental scenes while Space Grotesk keeps the process text direct.
